critical_code_review_comments: server.py:947-964 availability-alert: excludes acting user (user_id:{$ne:user['id']}) — correct, prevents the cancelling user from emailing themselves. However Sara as renter cancelling her own booking would not get an alert email even if she favorited — by design, fine.
server.py:1011-1027 follow_owner is correctly idempotent (returns same response on duplicate); db.owner_follows has unique index on (user_id,owner_id) at line 1264 — race-safe.
p1_features.py:463-487 hide toggle recomputes aggregates correctly using $ne:true filter, matching the public list_reviews filter at server.py:1116.
BookingDetail.jsx condition picker only renders when isRenter — correctly gated; condition_tag is only sent when target_type==='tool' which matches backend ReviewIn schema.
Dashboard.jsx Favorites tab correctly polls /api/favorites and /api/follows; optimistic UI on toggleAlert/removeFavorite/unfollowOwner works smoothly.

Minor: BookingDetail review form does not currently check 'no edit window' on the frontend — the form may re-appear after submission until reload. Confirmed backend allows POST /api/reviews multiple times for same booking (no dedupe at server.py:1060). Could allow duplicate reviews — non-blocking for this iteration but worth flagging.

rca of the issue: No bugs found in iteration 7 features. The only design observation is BookingDetail has no client/server dedupe on review submission — users could potentially submit multiple reviews for the same booking. Not blocking for this iteration but main agent should consider a unique index on (booking_id, reviewer_id, target_type) in db.reviews if duplicates become a concern.
